## Objective

Deliver a bounded derived projection and guarded adapter for the pinned local pilot.

## Scope

- Implement the Basic Memory projection
- Implement the guarded local query adapter
- Implement explicit backend maintenance
- Verify adapter boundaries without provisioning

## Entry conditions

- Pilot specification and memory/Task contracts are current.

## Exit criteria

- Adapter/maintenance contract tests pass without provisioning.
- No ordinary writer or mutating read path is admitted without live certification.

## Risks

- Serialize shared-file edits and honor every task-specific authority, preservation and evidence gate.

## TASK-025 - Implement the Basic Memory projection

Generate a derived Markdown projection containing only eligible project memories and allowlisted source evidence, with an exact manifest mapping backend entries to canonical identity, lifecycle, metadata and source digests. Map created/modified deliberately and never round-trip backend writes into canonical notes.

| State reason | None |

| Requirements | REQ-001, REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-012, REQ-013, REQ-014, REQ-019, REQ-022, REQ-026, REQ-030, REQ-050, REQ-051 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/memory/scripts/basic_memory_projection.py, MEMORY-depo/schema/backend-projection-v1.json |
| Dependencies | TASK-004, TASK-012, TASK-019, TASK-024 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- A derived projection limits the writer boundary but does not constitute an OS sandbox or prove the backend cannot reach other paths.

### Acceptance criteria

- Projection preserves custom provenance/chronology in retrievable mappings and canonical byte hashes remain unchanged.
- Excluded/sibling/non-active material is filtered before backend indexing and rechecked when results are resolved.

### Planned verification

- Run metadata/projection round-trip meaning checks for all five record types and source formats.
- Verify sentinel exclusions, changed canonical digests and backend-mutated projection rejection.

## TASK-026 - Implement the guarded local query adapter

Implement a thin adapter for the pinned Basic Memory profile with explicit project/config binding, fixed permitted query operations and canonical-result revalidation. Use backend queries only on a certified prebuilt profile; fall back to deterministic lexical/direct reads when startup would mutate or state is unavailable.

| Parallel group | None |

### Risks

- If no pinned API can satisfy strict read-only behavior, retain fallback and record pilot incompatibility; do not weaken REQ-017.

### Acceptance criteria

- Public reads expose no arbitrary backend writer/project/config command, startup sync, package/model download or cloud route.
- Result provenance and actual lexical/vector/hybrid mode are explicit, and frozen packet constraints apply after backend ranking.

### Planned verification

- Test adapter rejection/fallback for wrong project, altered profile, unsupported writer tools, stale projection and backend outage.
- Audit every imported/called backend entry point for writes and compare dry adapter requests to the fixed operation allowlist.

## TASK-027 - Implement explicit backend maintenance

Add an explicit maintenance route that materializes the approved projection and rebuilds only declared backend products using the pinned local profile. Check effective automatic-update, frontmatter, formatting, initialization, watch and routing controls, keeping configuration and recovery durable.

| Parallel group | None |

### Risks

- Backend defaults may perform maintenance automatically; verify effective values rather than trusting config file intent.

### Acceptance criteria

- Indexing is separately invoked and never runs inside public inspection or new-project setup.
- The maintenance receipt records version/config/projection and actual effects; canonical notes/Tasks/roles are unchanged and recovery data remains attributable.

### Planned verification

- Test wrong configuration, conflicting operation, interrupted rebuild and prohibited canonical target cases.
- Inspect declared state manifests and verify unknown files block broad replacement/deletion.
